top_signals.title: Shopify-Like IPO Successes Becoming Rare in Canada, Nowlan Says
top_signals.summary: Canada will struggle to find another stock-market success story like Shopify Inc. as the country grapples with a public-listing drought and a delisting trend, according to Daniel Nowlan at National Bank Capital Markets.

top_signals.title: Meta’s deal to keep Zuckerberg in California adds fuel to wealth tax debate ahead of election
top_signals.summary: With less than two weeks before the midterm elections, Meta made clear that Mark Zuckerberg is staying in California if the wealth tax passes.
